component.name: triib
component.summary: Discover, connect and set up AVB and Milan devices

description.p: triib is a lightweight ATDECC (IEEE 1722.1) controller with Milan and AVB Lite support. It finds the AVB devices on a network, reads what they offer and lets you connect and set them up.

ul.li: Connect talkers and listeners in a matrix, and save and recall presets
See the network as the devices' gPTP paths show it, with each stream's way through it
Change names, stream formats, sampling rates, clock sources, channel mappings and controls
Follow AVB Lite devices, their streams and the alarms the profile calls for
See what Wi-Fi stations and access points report under AVB Wireless
Log every ATDECC frame sent and heard, marking those that break the rules
Run Milan entities on this computer, routed to its audio, with a peak meter on each stream
Let AI agents read and change the network through MCP, once you let them in

description.p: Sending and receiving raw Ethernet needs the CAP_NET_RAW capability, which the package sets.

screenshot.caption: A show's network, each audio stream as its own wire
The gPTP clock tree, device by device

description.p: The network map draws the traffic on each link and places every device in its clock domain, those running AVB Lite behind the non-AVB switch in front of them, and the connection matrix keeps talkers and listeners in different domains from connecting. triib follows entities that send no notifications, shows entities' logos and their vendors', and on a Mac has a menu bar. On Linux only a small helper holds CAP_NET_RAW, and this computer's entities share their stream reservations with other programs such as plaa and hear other computers' AVB Lite declarations on the Intel I210.

A close button in the toolbar under compositors that draw no title bar, such as Hyprland and niri. triib starts on a Windows without the Visual C++ runtime, draws in software on Linux without a Vulkan driver rather than quitting, and on a Mac leaves Thunderbolt Bridge and USB-C network interfaces out of the interface picker.

The Streams tab, with a peak meter on each stream this computer carries, max transit times, media clock streams on host entities with any input as their clock source, the Basic Audio profile's channel counts and each output in its format's SR class. On a Mac, the Mac's own AVB entity as a host entity, with Listen for what it receives and sends. The macOS app and installer are signed with a Developer ID and notarized, and the installers say when this computer cannot be an AVB endpoint.

AVB Wireless status for entities and access points, devices of the computer's own with several streams each way, each with its own virtual audio device, SR class B talkers, a format menu in the connection matrix, AI agents through MCP with the user's consent, and on a Mac the Mac's own AVB entity.

The first release: discovery, a connection matrix, a map of the network and its clocks, entity settings, presets, a frame log and AVB Lite status on Linux, Windows and macOS, and on Linux talkers and listeners of the computer's own, on AVB and AVB Lite networks.
